notes: Episode-specific art for ep001. Paths are relative to public/episodes/ep001_farming/. Backgrounds: 3840x2160 (16:9) flattened illustrations with NO characters; keep the lower third readable for character placement. Objects: transparent PNG, base touching the bottom edge.

ep001.bg_bedroom.label: Bedroom at dawn
ep001.bg_bedroom.brief: Small apartment bedroom, cool pre-dawn blue light, window upper right, nightstand right of centre, empty bed area left-centre.

ep001.bg_office.label: Open-plan office
ep001.bg_office.brief: Grey open-plan office, fluorescent light, cubicles receding. Used for 3 shots with different framings, so keep it evenly detailed.

ep001.bg_dealership.label: Tractor dealership lot
ep001.bg_dealership.brief: Outdoor tractor dealership, bunting flags, big sky, sign area top. Open space centre-right for a giant tractor.

ep001.bg_living_room.label: Living room, evening
ep001.bg_living_room.brief: Cosy dim living room at night, TV on the right wall (screen at ~x 0.78, y 0.42), lamp light, space left-centre for the couch.

ep001.bg_farm_ingame.label: In-game farm field, daytime
ep001.bg_farm_ingame.brief: Bright idealised 'video game' farm field, rows of crops, road across the lower third.

ep001.bg_fantasy.label: Epic fantasy crag
ep001.bg_fantasy.brief: Stormy epic fantasy landscape, jagged peaks, lava glow. Empty centre for a dragon.

ep001.bg_action.label: Action-movie street
ep001.bg_action.brief: Blockbuster-style street with an (unrealistic, cartoon) explosion glow behind, sparks. Comedic, not graphic.

ep001.bg_castle.label: Fairy-tale castle
ep001.bg_castle.brief: Storybook castle, tall tower on the right with an open window at ~x 0.75, y 0.35.

ep001.bg_storm.label: Ominous sky, low horizon
ep001.bg_storm.brief: Dramatic dark clouds, very low horizon line (lower 15%), for a heroic low-angle shot.

ep001.bg_field_huge.label: Absurdly enormous field
ep001.bg_field_huge.brief: Flat field stretching to the horizon in every direction. IMPORTANT: the camera starts zoomed ~5x on the centre (x 0.5, y 0.64) — deliver at 7680x4320 or supply a separate high-res centre crop.

ep001.bg_city_evening.label: Apartment blocks at dusk
ep001.bg_city_evening.brief: Front-on apartment facades at dusk, grid of dark windows filling the upper 70% (windows light up via overlays).

ep001.bg_farm_panorama.label: Farm panorama (3 zones)
ep001.bg_farm_panorama.brief: Wide farm: crop rows on the left third, barn + fertilizer shed centre, animal pen right third. Camera visits each zone at 1.9x zoom.

ep001.bg_sunset_sky.label: Sunset sky (far layer)
ep001.bg_sunset_sky.brief: Sky only: warm sunset gradient, sun low at ~x 0.62, soft clouds. Parallax far layer.

ep001.mg_sunset_farm.label: Farm silhouette (mid layer)
ep001.mg_sunset_farm.brief: Transparent PNG strip: rolling fields, barn and silo silhouetted against the sunset. Parallax mid layer.

ep001.fg_fence.label: Wooden fence (near layer)
ep001.fg_fence.brief: Transparent PNG strip: wooden fence rail + tall grass, dark against the sunset. Nearest parallax layer.

ep001.alarm_clock.label: Alarm clock
ep001.alarm_clock.brief: Classic twin-bell alarm clock, 6:00 on the face.

ep001.email_icon.label: Email
ep001.email_icon.brief: Envelope / email notification card with a red unread badge.

ep001.paper_stack.label: Paperwork tower
ep001.paper_stack.brief: Tall wobbly stack of paperwork with sticky notes.

ep001.tractor_huge.label: Enormous shiny tractor
ep001.tractor_huge.brief: Gleaming brand-new green tractor, 3/4 front view, comically huge wheels, showroom shine. No real brand logos.

ep001.tractor_bigger.label: EVEN BIGGER tractor
ep001.tractor_bigger.brief: Same design language as tractor_huge but absurdly larger — double wheels, extra lights, a bow on top.

ep001.dragon.label: Epic dragon
ep001.dragon.brief: Classic fantasy dragon rearing up, wings spread, menacing but stylised to match the channel.

ep001.princess_tower.label: Princess in tower window
ep001.princess_tower.brief: Princess leaning out of a tower window, waving a handkerchief. Transparent.

ep001.window_lit.label: Lit window, tractor on TV
ep001.window_lit.brief: One apartment window at night: warm lamp light, silhouette of a person on a couch, TV glow showing a tiny tractor.
